rule: La phase N+1 ne peut démarrer qu’après fermeture documentée et preuve de sortie de la phase N et de ses dépendances; toute modification réouvre les phases dépendantes.

Runner reports 46/46, exit code 0 and only MainThread alive. Discovered and corrected drift between root and embedded docs; phase remains P5 RUNNING until full re-run reads synchronized documents.

P5 unit tests 6/6 and post-doc-sync P0-P5 regression 46/46 with confirmed exit code 0. RAG remains lexical BM25-like; supervised training only on explicit labels; candidate skill not generally certified.
